title: Pure Swordsoul
summary: Swordsoul cards with Incredible Ecclesia and generic staples; the Tenyi alliance and Branded hybrids are left out. Mo Ye, Taia and Longyuan each make a Level 4 Swordsoul Token Tuner, so every one of them is a Level 8 or 10 Synchro on its own, and Chixiao searches the next Swordsoul. The Tokens lock your Extra Deck to Synchros while they're out. The Three Champions of Swordsoul, the Chaos Origins Synchro, searches a Spellcaster with equal ATK and DEF such as Ecclesia, Iris or Golden Swordsoul, and negates a card. Archnemeses Protos, on the page's end board, is now Forbidden.
main: Swordsoul of Mo Ye
Summoned: reveals a Swordsoul to make a Swordsoul Token; as material, draws.
Swordsoul of Taia
Banishes a Swordsoul from the GY to make a Token; as material, mills a Swordsoul.
Swordsoul Strategist Longyuan
Discards a Swordsoul to summon itself with a Token; as material, burns.
Incredible Ecclesia, the Virtuous
Generic Level 4 Tuner the page runs; Three Champions searches it.
Swordsoul Auspice Chunjun
Tributes a monster to summon itself on either turn; as material, banishes a card.
The Golden Swordsoul
Negates an attack from the hand; revives a LIGHT Spellcaster when a card is banished.
The Iris Swordsoul
Summons itself next to a negated monster; punishes their Special Summons.
The Abyss Dragon Swordsoul
Summoned by a Wyrm, banishes a Field Spell and a monster; returns when a card is banished.
Swordsoul Emergence
Searches a Swordsoul, or any Wyrm with a Synchro out.
Swordsoul Sacred Summit
Revives a Swordsoul, or any Wyrm with a Synchro out.
Swordsoul Punishment
With a Synchro out, banishes a card from the field or a GY.
Swordsoul Blackout
Destroys a Wyrm and two opposing cards; banished, makes a Token.
Swordsoul Strife
Banishes a Swordsoul whenever cards are banished; banished, makes a Token.
Swordsoul Assessment
Pumps a monster for each Swordsoul banished; banished, makes a Token.
extra: Level 8: searches a Swordsoul card and negates a monster on either turn.
Newest support. Level 8: searches an equal-ATK/DEF Spellcaster and negates a card.
Level 10: banishes their summons and Spells/Traps for burn.
Level 10: banishes from their field and GY whenever cards are banished.
